_meta._comment: The stars that ARRIVE — GENERATED by tools/pipeline/import-gaia-neighbours.js --write (plan 28 §D). The Gaia DR3 six-dimensional stars within 1.5 kpc that ever reach V 8 within ±50 Myr on their Galactic orbits (ONE home packages/physics/src/sky/galactic-orbits.cjs), the stars of the Hipparcos catalogue (stars.json) excluded: the BRIGHT superset (M_G < 2, every star within 1.5 kpc) and, where `sourceFaint` is recorded, the FAINT one (M_G 2–5, pre-filtered server-side by the straight line's closest approach — complete to about ±20 Myr, thinning beyond; tools/pipeline/fetch-gaia-neighbours.js). The data are in stars-gaia.bin: Float32 little-endian COLUMN-MAJOR arrays, `columns` in order, `n` rows each — the astrometry at the Gaia epoch J2016.0, NOT propagated: the scene moves each star on its orbit. V and B−V are from G and BP−RP through the cubic polynomials in `colourRelations`, fitted here on the Hipparcos-matched rows. Gate: tools/verify/star-catalogue.js.

units.pmRaMasYr: milliarcseconds per Julian year, μα cos δ

faint.lineFilter: the straight line's closest approach ≤ 2 r(M) within |t_ca| ≤ 30 Myr, or d ≤ 2 r(M); r(M) = 10 pc × 10^((9 − M_G)/5)

colourRelations.form: c0 + c1·x + c2·x² + c3·x³, x = BP−RP clamped to colourFitRange; fitted on the Gaia rows matching a star of stars.json (V, B−V from the Hipparcos Catalogue), three passes of 3σ clipping

_meta.orbitModel: packages/physics/src/sky/galactic-orbits.cjs — the potential's exact evaluator (RK4, 0.5-Myr steps, the Sun on the same schedule); the closed form's amplitude counted as a diagnostic

source.title: Gaia DR3 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1): gaia_source within 1.5 kpc with radial velocities, brighter than M_G 2, joined to hipparcos2_best_neighbour — ESA, hosted by the Gaia archive
source.query: SELECT g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.radial_velocity, g.radial_velocity_error, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, x.original_ext_source_id AS hip FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour AS x ON x.source_id = g.source_id WHERE g.random_index BETWEEN <lo> AND <hi> AND g.parallax > 0.667 AND g.parallax_over_error > 5 AND g.radial_velocity IS NOT NULL AND g.pmra IS NOT NULL AND g.parallax < POWER(10, (12 - g.phot_g_mean_mag)/5)   — 64 chunks of random_index covering 0..1811709770, concatenated (tools/pipeline/fetch-gaia-neighbours.js --set bright)

sourceFaint.title: Gaia DR3 (the same release): gaia_source within 1.5 kpc with radial velocities, M_G 2 to 5, pre-filtered by the straight line's closest approach (≤ 2 r(M) within ±30 Myr, or within 2 r(M) today; r(M) the V-8 distance with a 1-mag colour margin), joined to hipparcos2_best_neighbour — the faint background, complete to about ±20 Myr
sourceFaint.query: tools/pipeline/fetch-gaia-neighbours.js --set faint (the WHERE clause is the script's SETS.faint.where): one asynchronous job as a registered archive user (--async --user), its rows ≡ the archive's COUNT; or anonymously in chunks on random_index, each verified against the COUNT
